name: gitcompass_triage
description: Analyzes open-source repo context and maps GitHub issues to file changes, test requirements, unified diffs, and PR blueprints.
author: GitCompass Open-Source Contributors

file_tree.description: Array of repository file paths relative to root

issue_title.description: Title of the GitHub issue or bug report

issue_body.description: Full description, reproduction steps, or stack trace

architecture_summary.description: Executive summary of relevant codebase modules and architectural flow

target_files.description: List of files that must be modified to resolve the issue

root_cause_or_design.description: Root cause analysis or architectural design rationale

pr_gameplan.description: Sequential steps required to implement and verify the PR

test_cases.description: Concrete test descriptions and assertions required for regression prevention

commit_message.description: Conventional commit message conforming to Angular/Conventional Commits spec
